story: TVC 20 s, Google ABCD (Attention, Branding, Connection, Direction). Why: on a hot hike her water is warm, but this tumbler still has ice at sunset. Shots: 1 hook (0-2 s) ice splashes into the tumbler, logo visible = brand in the first 5 s; 2 problem (2-5 s) hot dusty trail, she wipes sweat; 3 use (5-9 s) she pulls it from her backpack and sips; 4 proof (9-12 s) sunset, the lid opens, ice still inside; 5 detail (12-15 s) macro of the handle grip and steel base; 6 pack shot (15-20 s) on a rock, push-in, room for logo and call to action. Add music, SFX, logo and the line in the edit.
storyboard_prompts: Image 1 is the product photo: use exactly this product, its shape, materials, colours and logos. Create ONE storyboard image made of a 2x2 grid of four equal photo panels, edge to edge, with no borders, no gaps, no text and no numbers. Shot on a 35mm film camera, Kodak Portra 400, visible film grain, slight halation around highlights, natural unretouched colours, a real photograph, not a render. Wide 16:9 panels, a TV commercial. Cinematic commercial, 16:9 frame, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field. The tumbler in every panel: a large mint-green glossy insulated tumbler: a slightly tapered body, a raised mint-green band near the top, a matching mint-green C-shaped handle, a clear plastic lid with a mint-green straw, a brushed steel ring at the base, and the grey word 'reduce' printed vertically on the side. Panel 1 (top left): HOOK: extreme close-up of the open tumbler without its lid on a sun-bleached wooden bench, clear ice cubes splashing into it, cold water droplets flying, the grey word 'reduce' visible on the side. Panel 2 (top right): PROBLEM: a dusty mountain trail under hard midday sun from the upper right, one side lit, the other in deep shadow, heat shimmer in the distance. a young woman hiker in a sweat-darkened light-grey T-shirt, seen from the chest down only, dusty forearms with sun-flushed skin and fine pores, a small backpack strap on her shoulder; she never looks at the camera; she wipes sweat from her neck with the back of her hand, a scratched plastic water bottle hanging warm from her pack. Panel 3 (bottom left): USE: the same trail; a young woman hiker in a sweat-darkened light-grey T-shirt, seen from the chest down only, dusty forearms with sun-flushed skin and fine pores, a small backpack strap on her shoulder; she never looks at the camera; she holds the tumbler by its handle and sips through the straw, condensation-free mint-green body glinting in the sun. Panel 4 (bottom right): PROOF: the same tumbler on a flat rock at sunset, the lid flipped open, clear ice cubes still floating inside, long orange light, dust in the air. The tumbler has the same shape, proportions and colour in every panel; it is about the height of her forearm. Candid, unretouched photographs with natural imperfections: real dust, fingerprints, uneven light, slight lens vignetting. No extra products, no added text, no watermark.
